__description: P8-S7 dashboard TEMPLATE (Grafana-compatible JSON). Template form only — no deployed infra. Panels map the P8_S7_MONITORING_ALERTING_REPORT.md metric inventory (ops doc §7 categories + OBS-04 indicator set). Thresholds are CONFIGURABLE proposals (O-5).
title: iPoint V1 — Operations Overview (P8-S7 template)

panels.title: Auth failures & abuse (ops §7)
panels.description: Alert: IpointHighAuthFailureRate. Expected-outcome note: OBS-05 deprecated recharge 403s excluded by route matcher.

panels.title: OBS-04 class — idle-in-transaction on reconciliation path
panels.description: Alert: IpointIdleInTransaction + IpointReconcileRunStall. This is the known HIGH limitation made observable (S6 OBS-04 / D-070); remediation remains a Command Center decision. Probe: scripts/p8-s7/monitoring-probe.mjs.

panels.title: DB health — pool saturation & deadlocks (ops §7)
panels.description: Alerts: IpointPoolSaturation, IpointDeadlockDelta. S6 baseline: deadlock delta 0.

panels.title: Outbox backlog (ops §7 queue health)
panels.description: Alert: IpointOutboxBacklog. Expected-outcome note (OBS-03): reversed-transaction dispatch rejections are expected; watch backlog, not log lines. S6 baseline: 60 -> 0 in ~3s.

panels.title: Reconciliation differences & MCP failures (ops §7)
panels.description: Alerts: IpointLedgerReconciliationDifference, IpointMcpDebitFailureRate. Expected-outcome notes: OBS-01 quote 409s excluded; OBS-02 55P03 500s bounded.
